_meta: Owner: product owner (copy). Loaded by the notify and daily-reminder functions. {partner} = partner display name, {preview} = first 80 characters of a message (push payload only, never logged), {streak} = current streak. Rules from board S08 screen 39 and DESIGN_DELTA D23-D25. status=placeholder until the PO approves the copy; a type (or variant) with "status": "approved" is PO-approved copy (PO 2026-11-11: little_thing, trial_ending, offer_ending, thread_activity.voice_message). No prices in any push.

global.quiet_hours_behaviour: drop (do not queue) except ritual_reminder, which is never scheduled inside quiet hours

ritual_reminder.trigger: cron at ritual_time, only if the user hasn't answered today

default.title: Bonded
default.body: It's your ritual time. Today's question is waiting.

partner_answered.trigger: answer insert when answer_count becomes 1, sent to the partner who hasn't answered
partner_answered.title: {partner} answered today's question
partner_answered.body: Your turn. Answer to unlock theirs.

both_answered.trigger: answer insert when answer_count becomes 2, sent to the first answerer
both_answered.title: You both answered
both_answered.body: {partner}'s answer is ready. Hold to reveal.

thread_activity.trigger: thread message or reaction by the partner; group events within 5 minutes into one push

last_call.trigger: 22:30 local, streak >= 3 and today's question not answered by both
last_call.title: Your {streak}-day streak is waiting
last_call.body: Answer together before midnight to keep it going.

nudge.title: {partner} is waiting
nudge.body: {partner} is waiting to see your answer.

partner_joined.trigger: accept_invite success, sent to the inviter (transactional, not capped by toggles)
partner_joined.title: {partner} joined you on Bonded
partner_joined.body: You're paired. See today's question together.

partner_premium.trigger: entitlement becomes active for one member while the other was not premium
partner_premium.title: You're both Premium
partner_premium.body: {partner}'s plan covers you too. Every pack is open.

weekly_recap.title: Your week together
weekly_recap.body: You showed up {days} of 7 days. See your recap.

tips.trigger: manual campaigns only; opt-in, default off
tips.title: Bonded

little_thing.trigger: partner's little things (D48), 10 s after the send (undo window); gestures within 10 minutes grouped into one push
little_thing.quiet_hours_behaviour: delivered silently (no sound, no alert); counts toward max_per_person_per_day
little_thing.title: Bonded

trial_ending.trigger: day 5 of the 7-day trial (2 days before it ends), once per trial (transactional)
trial_ending.title: Your free trial ends in 2 days
trial_ending.body: Keep Premium for both of you, or cancel anytime in Settings.

offer_ending.trigger: day-3 gift (D52), once, 2 hours before the offer ends; only with the tips opt-in
offer_ending.title: Your gift ends soon
offer_ending.body: 25% off Premium for you both. Open it before it's gone.

celebration.trigger: partner taps Tell Sam on a personal milestone (49 to 50)
celebration.title: {partner} just hit {milestone}
